podcast.title: Golden Globe Nomination (2000s)
podcast.body: Sinead O'Connor received a Golden Globe nomination for a song that was featured in a film starring Glenn Close. "Mary J. Blige, a Golden Globe nomination for a song in a Glenn Close film."

xref.title: Collaboration (2000s)
xref.body: Sinead O'Connor collaborated with Dolly Parton as part of her ongoing activism in the 2000s, raising money for AIDS research and supporting people living with AIDS. "This is the kind of work she continued with in the 2000s, work with Dolly Parton, Mass of Attack, Mary J. Blige, a Golden Globe nomination for a song in a Glenn Close film."
